tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250klong gsal rdo rje'i snying po las: rgyal yum rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub pa'i thog mar gso sbyong gi cho ga bzhugs so: 1$0000300

༁ྃ: klong gsal rdo rje'i snying po las: yan lag tu rgyal yum rnam par rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi thog mar gso sbyong blang ba ni: tho rangs kyi cha la cho ga ba rnams kyi khrus bya: slob dpon la phyag 'tshal spyi gtsug thal mo sbyar la thog mar: mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri: rtsal chen seng ges btegs pa'i steng du: ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdangs ltar zhal gcig phyag gnyis: g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam gzhag can: mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa bsgom: thal mo sbyar la ni: ston pa dgongs su gsol: bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba: ston pa sangs rgyas kyi 'khor du byin gyis brlab tu gsol: skyob pa dam chos kyi snod du byin gyis brlab tu gsol: 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi mchog tu byin gyis brlab tu gsol: zhes gsol pas: slob dpon gyis: 'o khyed rnams thabs mkhas skal bar ldan: sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med: chos dang 'dra ba'i skyob pa med: dge 'dun 'dra ba'i zhing sa med: skal ldan 'jug pa'i mchog yin no: gsung ngo: yang zhus pa: de ltar 'jug pa'i chos spyod rnams: mgon pos bdag la bstsal du gsol: zhus pas: gsung pa: bstan pa'i gzhi ma skyabs 'gro ni: yang gzung thar pa'i them skas la: mgon pos khrid kyis gsol ba thobs: phyi nang phyed mdzad skyabs 'gro zhus: gsungs: yang zhus pa: ston pa dgongs su gsol: bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas: dus 'di nas gzung ste: ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du: rdzogs sangs rgyas pa yi: sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi 'o: yang zhus pa: ston pa dgongs su gsol: bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas: dus 'di nas gzung ste: ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du: yongs su rdzogs pa'i dam chos la skyabs su mchi 'o: yang zhus pa: ston pa dgongs su gsol: bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas:

dus 'di nas gzung ste: ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du: phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi 'o: slob dpon gyis thabs yin no: slob mas legs so brjod: yang zhus pa: slob dpon gyis: sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal skyabs song nas: ston pa'i 'khor du mos pa zungs: 'dod chags las gyur rtog pa spongs: skyabs 'gro sogs kyi bzlas par brtson: 'dir chos kyi bslab bya 'chad do: dge 'dun la yang skyabs song na: phyi rol grub mtha'i tshul chos dang: zhe sdang las gyur rtog pa spongs: dge 'dun bya ba'i spyod pa spyad: ces bslab pa bsgo 'o: slob dpon gyis me tog 'thor la: deng 'dir phyin chad bu khyod kyis: sangs rgyas 'khor la smon lam thobs: dam pa'i chos kyi snod du gyur: dge 'dun 'bras bu'i sa bon 'grub: de bzhin mchog tu skal pa bzang: zhes me tog 'thor: yang gsol ba: sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor: 'phags pa dgra bcom tshogs rnams kyis: spyod pa'i tshul la ji ltar bslabs: ston pas bdag la bstsal du gsol: zhes zhus pas: slob dpon gyis: de ring ston pa rin chen chos: lus can kun gyi skyabs mchog ste: 'di yi snod du ma gyur med: dgra bcom tshul des de ltar min: ces gsungs pas: ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom gyis: tshul gyis spyod pa gang yin pa: ston pas bdag la gsung du gsol: mkhan pos bdag la gsung du gsol: zhus pas: gsung pa: sngon tshe dgra bcom 'bras bu'i chos: spyod pa'i tshul la brten bcas nas: dgra bcom 'bras bu grub na 'ang: 'jug sgo dam pas spyad par dka': 'on kyang ston pa thabs mkhas kyis: nyin gcig tsam gyi sdom pa dang: sna re tsam gyi bsrung sdom bstan: de bzhin don la gsol ba thobs: smras pas: yang gsol ba btab pa ni: ston pa bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas: de ring gi tshe na: 'phags pa dgra bcom pa'i spyod pa la 'jug gis:

mgon pos rjes su zungs shig: ces zhus pas: gsung pa: sngon tshe 'phags pa dgra bcom gyis: srog gcod ma byin len pa dang: 'dod log mi gtsang spyod spangs pas: de ring tshe na de bzhin srung: sha chang sgog tsong dus min zas: rdzun dang glu gar tshul min spongs: mkhan por gsol ba btab pa dang: tshul la gnas pa'i spyod pa gyis: gsung pas: dam du bca' ba ni: slob dpon dgongs su gsol: de ring gi tshe na: ston pas gnang ba'i: sdom pa la gnas par bgyi 'o: bslab par bgyi 'o: 'jug par bgyi 'o: slob dpon gyis thabs yin no: gsungs pas: legs so brjod: gcig bzhi brgyad dang bcu bzhi lnga: nyer gnyis nyer lnga gnam gang la: nyis gcig gam ni sna gcig srung: yongs rdzogs srung sogs 'grub gyur na: sangs rgyas smon lam thobs shig grol: dgra bcom 'bras bu'i sa bon 'jog: bla med mchog la reg par 'gyur: zhes gsungs: deng nas khyed rnams skal pa bzang: dga' dang ldan pas chos spyod cig: ces me tog 'thor: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ma mo gza' dang rdo rje legs pas srungs shig: ces brtse ba'i grogs po pad+ma mkha' spyod kyis bskul ba'i dpal las/ lha dang bla mas byin gyis brlabs shing rtag tu skyong ba'i pho brang nyams dga' ba'i dkyil rdzogs chen pa klong gsal snying pos dag par phab pa'o/// / 1$0000250༁ྃ: klong gsal rdo rje'i snying po las: gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sngags byang bzhugs so: 1$0000300༁ྃ: oṃ na mo bha ga wa te: sarba trai lokya pra ti bi shiṣ+ṭā ya: bhud+dhā ya te na ma: tad+ya thā: oṃ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐: shwa dha ya shwa dha ya: bi shwa dha ya bi shwa dha ya: a sa ma sa man+ta ta: a wa bha sa: s+pha ra ṇa ga te: ga ga na swa bhā wa: bhi shud+dhe: uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya pa ri shud+dhe: a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ: sarba ta thā ga tā: su ga ta wa ra wa tsa na: a mṛta a bhi ṣe ke ra ma hā mu drā: man+t+ra pa dai: ā ha ra ā ha ra:

ma ma ā yu san dhā ra ṇi: shwa dha ya shwa dha ya: bhi shwa dha ya bhi shwa dha ya: ga ga na swa bhā wa bhi shud+dhe: uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya pa ri shud+dhe: sa ha sra rasmi sañtso di te: sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te: ṣ+ṭa pā ra mi tā pa ri pu ra ṇi: sarba ta thā ga ta mā te: da sha bhū mi pra tiṣ+ṭhi ti: sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya: a dhiṣ+ṭhā na: a dhiṣ+ṭhi te: mu dre mu dre: ma hā mu dre: badz+ra ka ya: saṃ ha ta na: pa ri shud+dhe: sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bhi shud+dhe: pra ti ni war+dha ya: ma ma ā yuḥbhi shud+dhe: sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma yā: a dhiṣ+ṭhā na: a dhiṣ+ṭhi te: oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni: bi mu ni bi mu ni: ma hā bi mu ni: ma ti ma ti: ma hā ma ti: ma ma ti su ma ti ta thā tā: bhū ta ko tri pa ri shud+dhe: bhi s+phu ṭa: shud+dhe shud+dhe: he he: dza ya dza ya: bi dza ya bi dza ya: sma ra sma ra: smā ra ya smā ra ya: s+pha ra s+pha ra: s+phā ra ya s+phā ra ya: sarba bhud+dha: a dhiṣ+ṭhā na: a dhiṣ+ṭhi te: shud+dhe shud+dhe: bhud+dhe bhud+dhe: badz+re badz+re: ma hā badz+re: su badz+re: badz+ra gar+bhe: dza ya gar+bhe: bhi dza ya gar+bhe: badz+ra dz+wā lā gar+bhe: badz+rod bha we: badz+ra saṃ bha we: badz+re badz+re ni: badz+ram bha ṣiñtsa tu: ma ma shā rī ram: sarba satwā nāñtsa kā ya: pa ri shud+dhe bhag wan+tu: me sa da sarba ga te: pa ri shud+dheñtsa: sarba ta thā ga t+ṣ+tsa māṃ: sa mā shwā sa yan+tu: bud dh+ya bud dh+ye: sid+dh+ye sid+dh+ye: bod+dh+ya bod+dh+ya: bi bo dh+ya bi bo dh+ya: mo tsa ya mo tsa ya: bi mo tsa ya bi mo tsa ya: shwa dha ya: shwa dha ya: bhi shwa dha ya bhi shwa dha ya: sa man+tā+o: mo tsa ya mo tsa ya: sa man+ta rasmi pa ri shud+dhe: sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya: a dhiṣ+ṭhā na: a dhiṣ+ṭhi te: mu dre mu dre: ma hā mu dre: ma hā mu drā man tra: pā daiḥswā hā: nye sngags snying po ni: oṃ a mṛ te ā yur da de swā hā: ma mo gza' dang rdo rje legs pas srungs shig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:

zhes yid kyi grogs po pad+ma mkha' spyod kyis bskul ba'i dpal las rdzogs chen pa klong gsal snying pos dag par phab pa'o/// / 1$0000250༁ྃ: klong gsal rdo rje'i snying po las: rgyal yum rnam par rgyal ma'i las mjug nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs so: 1$0000300༁ྃ: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ e ma ho: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: 'gro la bde skyid 'byung don du: phyogs las rnam par rgyal ma yi: sku rten las mjug 'di bzhin no:1$0000270 ma 'ong bzhi bcu khar la sum cu nye ba'i 1$0000300 1$0000270dus: 'gro ba yongs la phyi nang gi 'tshe ba gang dag srung ba'i thabs: rin po che sna tshogs: 'bru sna tshogs: dar zab: gnas chen dang sa dpyad bzang ba'i sa sna: ri bo 'phan bzang ming chen snyan grags can gyi rtsa dang 'bras sna: byin rlabs can gyi rdzas gang 'dzoms kyis lha mo'i sku gzugs rab sde dpon gyi 'dom gang: 'bring gru gang: tha ma mtho gang ba leg par bzhengs pa'i thugs dpal gyi be'ur bkra shis pa'i gzungs sngags dang: lha dang srung ma chags pa'i rdzas sna bco brgyad ni: ga pur gur gum ghi haṃ sug smel li shi cu gang a ka ru a ru ra rnam rgyal lam gser mdog: a mṛta: dzā ti: tsan+dan dkar po tsan+dan dmar po spos dkar spang spos zi la rnams so: lte ba na srid pa 'khor lo 'dod gsol spel tshig dang bcas pa rin po che: yul gru mang po'i 'bru sna: dar zab rnams so: thugs ka'i thad du 'byor pa drug spel ba'i gzungs 'dod gsol dang bcas pa: thad kyi sna tshogs rdo rje'i khong seng nang du brtan byed kyi spel tshig dang rdo rje pha lam: med na gser gyi ye dharmā gzhug: mnyam gzhag gi mthil bum pa'i nang du tshe dpag med kyi gzungs sngags dang gangs ri 'gyur med kyi sa rdo g.yu mtsho gtan 'khyil gyi chus sbrus pa'i ril bu'i khengs: bum pa'i kha rgyan du sangs rgyas a mi dhe wa'am tshe dpag med kyi sku bzhugs pa'i thugs kar ā yu dmar po'i sngags dang:

grub pa thob pa nges can gyi ring bsrel gzhug: g.yas kyi mda' khong seng gi nang du dal yams g.yul zlog gi sngags dang: bgegs dang log 'dren bskrad pa'i rdzas sna bco brgyad ni: gu gul: gla rtsi shing kun chu dag nag po sgog gcig bya rgod spu ba bla sdong ros mu zi ser po nag po spru ba mkhan dmar mkhan nag rtsa ba rgya shog phur mo'i lo ma'o: g.yon gyi gzhu yi 'chang gzung khong seng gi nang du phyogs non gyi sngags la ngar 'dog gi rdzas dgu ni: btsan dug rgya thang khrom thar nu re lcag bong dug spru ba spyang tsher tsher nag go: sku yi byin la so sor gzungs gzhug rin po ches bris pa nor 'khrul med pa gzhug: ral pa'i dbus su lha mo gtsug rgyan gyi gzugs la sogs gzhug nas tshon rtsis bsgyur la mdzod du pha rol gang gis ma rig par rab gnas mchod 'bul la brtson pas sde dgon gang la bde skyid la rked chad mi 'byung ba dang mi nyams pa'i nus pa ldan par 'gyur ro: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ma mo gza' dang rdo rje legs pas srungs shig: 1$0000300 zhes grogs kyi dam pa pad+ma mkha' spyod kyis bskul pa'i dpal las gu ru rin po che'i shog ser las bdag nyid klong gsal snying pos dag par phab pa'o/// / 1$0000250༁ྃ: klong gsal rdo rje'i snying po las: rnam rgyal ma'i las mjug gi ngar 'dog srung zlog gi gnad 'jug bzhugs so: 1$0000300 ༁ྃ: ྈྈྈྈྈ srung zlog las kyi gnad 'jug: ྈྈྈ lha mo rnam rgyal gyi gzungs kyi mthar bkra shis pa'i las mtha' rin po ches bris: na mo bhud+dha ya gu ru bhai: ār+ya pi pa bha ga wan: ta thā ga to ar ha te: sam myag sam bhud+dho: bīt+ya tsa ra na sa ma: pa ṇa na su ga te: lo ka bīt+ya mud tā ra: pu tu ra shā da mya sa ra thi: shasta dhi wa ra tsa ma ṇu ṇu sha: tsa shud+dho bha ga wan ni ṇ+yan ta: ta thā ga ta bh+ya naṃ: oṃ bh+ya pra ṇa sha: ku sha la: mu lan ma: a bhi laṃ kri t+ya ldan t+ya ā ga ma puṇ+yai bri dhā nā:

ni tsi tri tā+o: a ṇu n+yañtsa bhe: ku su me ta li: ki ṇa pra ti sbu smu go tsa ran a pra ti ku lo dar sha ne na: a ti bhi ra ti shra: dha dhi mu ga tog nam: a na bi su to bhi mu ka: tad pa rang kā dhe: pa re mu ka ta s+t+ri nā yā: pa re ru ླྞ dz+nyā na ṇi shi na: pra tiṣ+ṭha to a ḍi swā hā: nā ga ta pra dhu ta pan+na naṃ bud+dha naṃ: bha ga bha re dz+nyā ne na: a pra tiṣ+ṭha ti bhid bha n+sh+thi bhud+dhe kan+yoṣ+ṭhi ta: sā+o ta laṃ ka ni: ya bhā mā: bud+dha a nu smra to sa ma ya swā hā: bkra shis rdzas brgyad yang gzhug: na ma sa man+ta bhud+dha na: a pra ti ha: sha sa nan ṇa: oṃ ka ṇi ka ṇi: ta thā ga to: da pa sha na: he ba ra ti: ū ta ma ta ta: su ga to ta bha wa: hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: na mo bhud+dha ya: oṃ dhu na dhu na: ma hā bhi re hūm̐ phaṭa: maṃ ga sa bha wan tu pa ri shu bhuṃ ni dha dz+wa la dz+wa la bhi dza bhi dz+wo puṣ+ṭaṃ ku ru hūm̐ swā hā: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i 'dod gsol spel tshig dang bcas pa gzhug: thad kyi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar ྈྈ rig pa rang gnas 'bras bu brgyad kyi sham bu: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par brtan par gyur cig: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐: de bzhin du shar du: ྈྈྈྈྈ 'khor dang mnga' thang rgyas pa brtan par gyur cig: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐: lhor: ྈྈྈྈྈ yid bzhin dpal 'byor rgyas par brtan par gyur cig: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐: nub tu: ྈྈྈྈྈ mgon zhing 'go ba'i lha dang srung ma rgyas pa brtan par gyis shig: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐: byang du: ྈྈྈྈྈ bkrag dang gzi brjid rgyas pa brtan par gyur cig: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐: ces so: tshe gzungs ni gzhung bzhin no: ā yu dmar po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi snying po ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru ā yu sid+dhi a mā ra ṇi dzi ban+ti swā hā: oṃ tshe bh+rūm̐ g.yu bh+rūm̐ g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: pad+ma sid+dhi ā yu shrī hūm̐ r+nṛ dza: ṭa ṭa sha mu tra ho tiṣ+ṭha lhan:

ces so: zlog sngags ni: oṃbhamānāsh+natrisan+sasar+b+sarmarapargyargya.ekecihūm̐thamasagirusarkurbabiharganapargyargaranibaduhūm̐phaṭabadhakas+yagabhabehahahebazlogayatebazlogayamaratsamarayarabazlogasadutriphutris mayabazlog: ces pa gsal bar bris pa'i shog dril mda' nang du gzhug: g.yon gyi 'chang gzung la: oṃ badz+ralogatripālanan: sagapashanan: nāgadudunan: mamaṃmamaṃcitsaracitsar: baṃrulubaṃrulu: rbadatrakoshaya: horahoraganodabyedatsidunanatsidunan: halapatrinan: parayashudh+rithunabh+yo: shasharalametogabashutsesarbanananan: zhes gzhug go: gzhan yang: na mo bhud+dhe bye: oṃ na mo sa man+ta bhud+dha naṃ: gtsug gtor la'o: badz+ra ha ho hūm̐ phaṭa: dbu skra la'o: oṃ tri yad dhi sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya: gar+bhe dz+wa la dharmā dhar+dhu gar+bhe saṃ ha ra ā yu saṃ shwa dha ya: pā paṃ ta thā ga ta hri da ya sa man+ta ta thā ga ṣiñtsa bi ma bi shud+dhe swā hā: klad pa dung khang la'o: oṃ ru ru te sa ta sid+dhi lo tsa na sarba a dha sa dha naṃ swā hā: spyan gnyis la'o:

badz+ra ho hūm̐ phaṭa: mdzod spu la'o: badz+ra ha re swā hā: smin ma la'o: badz+ra dhe ho dha swā hā: rna ba la'o: badz+ra te ba bye te swā hā: sna la'o: badz+ra ho hūm̐ swā hā: mchu la'o: badz+ra he te swā hā: lce la'o: badz+ra ha re ra swā hā: phyag gnyis la'o: sarba ho a baṃ swā hā: gsang ba la'o: oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: badz+ra gar+bhe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra b+ngīr+ya swā hā: sku bying la mang bris so: lha mo gtsug rgyan ma'i gzungs snyan brgyud nor bu las khol du phyung ba yang shes par bya'o: badz+ra sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈ ༁ྃ: ྈྈ dus kyi snyigs mar ma rungs pa'i: byad kha rbod gtong lha 'dre'i zug: mi mthun tha dag zlog mdzad pa'i: rnam par rgyal ma'i mchod rten bzhengs: ྈྈ che chung ma nges ci yang rung: cha gnyis ldan pa'i sa yi stegs: cha gnyis la ldan pad+ma ste: cha phran de yi bang rim bzhi: zhi ba'i tshul gyis zlum po bskor: cha bdun ldan pas bum pa dang: gnyis kyi bre ske'i bre la gnyis: pad+ma gnyis dang chos 'khor drug: gdug gcig nyi zla nor bu gnyis: yas rim tshul du mngon par 'phags: sa gzhi cha phran bcu dgu yi: yas rim phan tshun re re bzhag: de bzhin rigs pa'i 'gros bzhin bzhengs: bzang drug ut+pal tsan+dan gnyis: zho sha gsum dang 'bras bu gsum: dbang lag chu srin sder mo sogs: klu la 'byor ba'i sman rnams bsres: rin chen lnga dang 'bru dang dar: shing sna chu sna'i tshogs kyis bzhengs: rten la 'tsham pa'i brtan bzhugs dang: rab gnas brtan bzhugs me tog phul: 'byung ba mi mthun dgrar gyur dang: lha 'dre'i 'tshe ba rbod gtong dang: dus 'khor sa bdag ma rungs sogs: zhi gyur mchog la the tshom med: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: klong gsal snying po'i zab gter lags so/// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
